description: The plot illustrates how the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” changes across different input lengths for four model/dataset conditions shown as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled with token counts (128, 256, 512, 1024) on a linear scale, spanning 128 to 1024 with irregular tick spacing corresponding to those four values. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” on a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.55, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. A blue solid line with circular markers increases from about 0.20 at 128 to about 0.25 at 256, rises to about 0.35 at 512, and ends near 0.36 at 1024. An orange solid line with square markers increases from about 0.15 at 128 to about 0.23 at 256, rises to about 0.42 at 512, and remains about 0.42 at 1024. A green solid line with upward-triangle markers increases from about 0.06 at 128 to about 0.21 at 256, rises to about 0.37 at 512, and ends near 0.38 at 1024. A red solid line with diamond markers increases from about 0.24 at 128 to about 0.26 at 256, rises to about 0.43 at 512, and increases further to about 0.52 at 1024.
